## Golfu (CR 4)

This huge, brown-feathered owl is taller than a human, with massive talons and stern amber eyes.  

**XP** 1,200  
N Large magical beast  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +6 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 65 (5d10+15)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  
**Melee** bite +8 (2d6+4), talon +8 (1d6+4)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** petrifying callback, petrifying screech  


**Statistics**


**Str** 18, **Dex** 15, **Con** 17, **Int** 5, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Stealth)  
**Skills** Fly +4, Perception +8, Stealth +5  
**Languages** Common (cannot speak)  


**Special Abilities**



**Petrifying Callback (Su)** Once per day, if the golfu succeeds on a save against a spell or effect that targets it, as an immediate action it can utter a petrifying screech that affects only the creature that created the effect, as long as that creature is within 60 feet. It can use this ability in the same way when a creature confirms a critical hit against it.  

**Petrifying Screech (Su)** A golfu’s monstrous screech causes all living creatures within 30 feet to become slowed (as the spell) for 1d4 rounds (DC 15 Fort negates), as those who fail the save have their flesh and bones harden. A creature slowed by its screech that fails another save against it is paralyzed 1d4 rounds, and a creature already paralyzed that fails a third save is petrified 1.
